subject: Repack proposal: visualization + archival credits and surge cushion
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <etorres@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Visualization + Archival: proposed repack & cushion for pilot

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for walking through the retention and dashboard use cases yesterday. Based on your traffic profile (mostly short traces, occasional archive retrievals and heavy dashboarding for ops), I sketched a packaging alternative that aims to reduce unit costs while giving you a predictable overage cushion for spikes.

Proposal highlights (attached):
- Visual Layer (advanced dashboards): slab pricing with 10 dashboard seats, 25% off list for a 12-month commit
- Archival retention tiering: move long-tail snapshots to a lower-cost cold bucket with a 30-day restore SLA; nominal per-GB archive fee
- Tracing surge cushion: monthly burst credits that cover 2x baseline short-term spikes; additional bursts billed at meter rates

Attached: ACME_SOW_v2.pdf and an excerpted pricing model (redwood-visual-pricing-model.xlsx).

Questions for you: Is a 12-month commit acceptable? Do you want the surge cushion to be sized by historical 95th percentile or a fixed token credit?

Next steps: if you like this direction I can loop in Ben and Laura to finalize concession matrix and SOW language.

Thanks,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft), redwood-visual-pricing-model.xlsx (pricing workbook)

From: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <etorres@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visualization + Archival: proposed repack & cushion for pilot

Hi Olga,

Appreciate the clear write-up. A few quick clarifications from our side:
1) We can do a 12-month commit but would prefer a staged ramp (25% year 1, 75% year 2) — can concessions be front-loaded?
2) For the surge cushion, 95th percentile sounds sensible but can you show cost delta for a fixed cushion (easier for our finance team to forecast)?
3) Elena flagged legal: we need a SLT for archival restores (RM policy requires <48 hours for restores unless exceptions are granted).

Also — would you consider a 35% discount on advanced dashboards given our pilot scope and potential enterprise rollout?

Best,
Samir
Head of Product, Acme Health

Quick draft concession table attached (concession-table-ACME.csv). Summary:
- Dashboards: 20% standard, 25% if commit front-loaded to year 1, 30% requires Director approval, 35% requires VP approval + $Xk revenue guarantee.
- Archival restore SLA: we can offer <=48h for cold restores at pilot scale with a written SLA addendum; anything faster needs ops sign-off and a modest fee.
- Surge cushion: propose fixed monthly credits sized at 1.5x baseline (finance-friendly), with an option to convert to a 95th-percentile billing after month 3.

Callout: Legal needs to review SLA language; Finance needs to accept the front-loaded recognition.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concession table & cushion sizing (ACME)

Attaching short cost delta extract: redwood-visual-pricing-model.xlsx (sheet: cushion-comparison). TL;DR:
- Fixed cushion (1.5x baseline credits): estimated incremental cost to Redwood ~ $2.6k/month; customer-facing premium ~ $3.8k/month.
- 95th percentile model: expected bill volatility +/- 20% vs fixed cushion; long-run expected revenue similar but harder for customer to forecast.

Recommendation: offer fixed cushion for first 6 months, include an optional conversion to 95th after 90 days with a readout. This balances ACME's finance ask and Redwood's risk.

Also noted: a 30-day cold restore SLA maps to our standard cold-tier restore workflow — ops can meet 48h but need explicit “expedited restore” flag in ticket flow for <24h.

Laura
Pricing & Packaging | Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the ask on dashboard discount. Based on internal review I can offer the following for pilot SOW:
- Advanced dashboards: 25% off list for a 12-month commit with a staged ramp (25% year 1 recognition, remainder in year 2). Were including 1 pilot credit tranche to reduce your upfront cash.
- Archival restores: Redwood will commit to <=48h for cold restores for pilot volume; expedited restores <24h available as a paid add-on. We will have Legal draft the SLA addendum.
- Surge cushion: fixed monthly credits sized at 1.5x baseline (finance-friendly). After month 3 we will run a usage readout and offer conversion to a 95th-percentile billing model if you prefer.

I attached the updated SOW (ACME_SOW_v2.pdf) and the concession table. If that works I will send a DocuSign with the SOW and a starter invoice for the pilot credit.

If ACME needs us to get to 30%+ discount on dashboards we'd need a guaranteed revenue commitment and Director approval. Happy to discuss on a quick call.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_SOW_v2.pdf, concession-table-ACME.csv
